Rhiannon Henkels is marked as the incumbent because the City of Grants Pass's official certification letter addresses her as Josephine County Clerk; other incumbent flags are not set because we did not check an official roster. No circuit court contest appears for Josephine County. measures.title: Renewal of Current Five-Year Jail and Juvenile Local Option Tax
measures.summary: Referred by the Josephine County Board of Commissioners, this renews for five years, beginning in 2027-2028, the current local option property tax of $0.93 per $1,000 of assessed value. By law the money may be used only for adult jail operations, juvenile detention operations and related administrative costs; the county says it would keep jail capacity at 185 and allow intake of all adults arrested in the county. The county estimates $93 a year per $100,000 of assessed value and about $57.1 million over five years.
measures.yesMeans: Josephine County would continue its $0.93 per $1,000 jail and juvenile detention local option tax for five more years starting in 2027-2028.
measures.noMeans: The current jail and juvenile detention local option tax would expire on June 30, 2027.
